runs.about: Fresh small-model agent (haiku), identical bounded task, one run per side. n=1: variance between runs of the same side was not measured, so differences are indicative, not significant.
runs.task: 2D game 'lighthouse': 3 oil cans open a door, spikes cost lives with a cooldown, a checkpoint flag with pit respawn (before the flag: the start), 60 s countdown, HUD, three scenarios (door blocks, bot wins, standing still loses), verify passes. A composition of four mechanics; none is a copy of one pattern.

before.engine: main + browser phase 2a (no mechanics catalogue, search without the lane)
before.verify: 20 passed (includes audio checks for the sounds it added)
before.requirements_met: all, plus music, sounds, a restart button (not asked for)

after.engine: this pass (recipe lists 7 verified mechanics, search lane, describe 2d pointer)
after.requirements_met: all but one sub-requirement: a pit hit BEFORE the flag does not send the player back to the start; spikes and pits share one hazard tag
after.report_overclaim: its own report said 'nothing fails'; grading found the gap
